name: GoDoxy
description: GoDoxy is a lightweight, performant reverse proxy with an embedded WebUI, file-based routes, automatic certificates, and Proxmox integration.

notes.text: The WebUI password is stored in /etc/godoxy.env.
The initial HTTPS certificate is self-signed. Replace it or configure an ACME provider in /opt/godoxy/config/config.yml for a trusted certificate.
File-based routes can be added to /opt/godoxy/config/routes.yml; Docker is not installed or required.
